ThingDef.label: field recorder and radio
ThingDef.description: A rugged recorder with a short-range radio. Carry it into a coordinate to log visited rooms, route mismatches and entity observations. It is physical equipment and must return with the crew or be recovered later.

ThingDef.label: route recording
ThingDef.description: A unique physical recording recovered from an explored coordinate. Preserve it, return it with the field evidence case, then analyze it at a powered field analysis bench. Case identity, observations and analysis progress are saved. Destroyed evidence is not recreated on revisiting the site.
